findings.summary: The required P01-01 command exits 1 (7 failed / 49 passed) because the DSH evidence refresh (round n03-2026-10-04, written 2026-10-04T16:01:57Z) changed the evidence schema while the frozen P01-01 integration tests still read the old schema fields from that same file.
findings.detail: tests/integration/test_p01_01_workspace_bootstrap.py reads artifacts/handoffs/P01-01/dsh/evidence.json (EVIDENCE_PATH, line 30) and consumes evidence['python_workspace_members'] (line 234), evidence['artifacts']['uv_lock'|'package_lock'] as a dict (lines 238/265), evidence['dependencies_lock'][...] (240/269), evidence['tool_versions']['node'|'python'] (283/290) and evidence['legacy_demo'][...] (297/307). The delivered evidence has artifacts as a LIST and none of python_workspace_members / tool_versions / legacy_demo / dependencies_lock, so seven tests fail with KeyError/TypeError: test_installed_distributions_cover_every_member, test_uv_lock_hash_matches_recorded_evidence, test_npm_lock_hash_matches_recorded_evidence, test_node_runtime_satisfies_the_pinned_baseline, test_python_runtime_satisfies_the_pinned_baseline, test_legacy_demo_tree_is_untouched, test_workspace_bootstrap_did_not_touch_demo_zip.
findings.root_cause: The DSH evidence rewrite invalidates its own prior verification: N03's recorded 56-passed task-suite run executed while the previous (old-schema) evidence was still on disk; after writing the new-schema evidence the suite was not re-run, so the delivered state fails its own contract. The candidate (77-file whitelist, including the tests) is byte-identical to the previous round, so the regression comes solely from the evidence file outside the whitelist.
findings.responsible_party: DSH-A N03 refresh round (owner of artifacts/handoffs/P01-01/dsh/evidence.json). Not caused by any candidate implementation file and not caused by this precheck session.
findings.recovery: Re-deliver the P01-01 evidence compatible with the frozen test contract: either restore the consumed fields (python_workspace_members, tool_versions, legacy_demo, dependencies_lock, artifacts as a dict keyed by uv_lock/package_lock/...) alongside the new governance fields, or obtain a governance-approved test update as a new candidate (which would require full re-verification).
